a continuous biotransformer with cell recycling is an alternative to a fed-batch plant for the production of L-carnitines.

continuous cell-recycling processes are not suitable for the production of l-carnitines.

the integration of fermentation and downstream processing.

continuous cell-recycle processes can be a good alternative to discontinuous processes, but only if the cell-recycling system is reliable and the microbial performance is sufficient.
